chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Subah al-Kinani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The believer dies by every type of death except the thunderbolt; it does not seize him while he is remembering Allah, Exalted and Majestic.
ai.seo_question: What type of death is a believer protected from while remembering Allah?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (as), emphasizing that the specific divine protection from a sudden, violent death by thunderbolt is contingent upon the believer's active state of dhikr. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that spiritual vigilance (muraqabah) not only preserves the soul's connection to the Divine but also serves as a tangible safeguard against abrupt physical demise, reinforcing the efficacy of continuous remembrance in both spiritual and worldly realms.
